title: MembershipCredential credential subject
description: The credential subject of an MDS MembershipCredential, as validated by a verifier that resolves the credentialSchema of the presented credential. Backs the ParticipantId and Membership policy operands of profile version 2026/1.

id.description: The holder's DID. MUST equal the DID that authenticates in the presentation exchange.

participantId.description: The participant identifier assigned at onboarding. Bound to the ParticipantId policy operand.

active.description: Whether the membership is in good standing. Bound to the Membership policy operand.
